text:
incident-bot: Pager: Billing anomaly detected — token-count drift in ingest pipeline (ingest-prod-01). Ticket INC-2026-343 created. Severity: P2. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-343
amanda: who is oncall? seeing overage emails start to fire.
lee: I'm oncall. Looking at alerts — token counts jumped ~40% for a subset of accounts starting ~01:12 UTC. Hypothesis: emitter retry amplification + kafka consumer hiccup.
jordan: grabbing dashboards now. quick checks: kafka consumer lag ~48k on ingest-partition-7, emitter_retry_rate spiked 3x at 01:12.
sarah-sales: are customers impacted / which ones? Need to know if we should pause alerts and notify AE.
amanda: initial: 12 accounts flagged with auto-overage; two enterprise (AcmeCorp, Brightline). Pausing automated billing notices recommended.
lee: Plan: 1) mute automated overage emails, 2) reduce emitter retry window (EMITTER_MAX_RETRIES), 3) run dedupe reprocess for last 1h, 4) create manual billing holds for affected accounts. Doing step 1 now.
incident-bot: Action: muted rule billing.overage.auto_notify by amanda at 1759513600.
lee: Running quick mitigation to reduce duplicates:
```
kubectl exec -n billing deploy/emitter -- /bin/sh -c \"export EMITTER_MAX_RETRIES=1 && pkill -HUP emitter\"
```
jordan: kicking reprocess job for last hour (dedupe=true):
```
POST /internal/reprocess?range=1h&dedupe=true
{"job_id":"reproc-175951"}
```
sarah-sales: I'll prepare a short customer note for #support-escalations but will hold sending until we verify reprocess results. Draft: "We are investigating a metering anomaly that may have caused incorrect overage notifications. Automated notices are paused while we validate and correct counts."
amanda: quick query showing duplicates in events table:
```
SELECT account_id, count(*) as tokens FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY account_id HAVING count(*) > 1000000;
```
AcmeCorp shows ~2.3M tokens in that window.
lee: Created manual billing hold for the 12 accounts (billing.hold = TRUE). Reprocess job queued. ETA ~8m.
incident-bot: reproc-175951 started at 1759513725, status=running.
jordan: sample staging run reduced duplicates by ~87% for the same window. If prod matches, we should be able to backfill and clear flags.
amanda: Oncall handoff — I have a meeting in 20m but will stay until reprocess final. Who takes post-incident tasks?
elaine: I can take postmortem + customer comms. Will coordinate with sales and charge ops.
sarah-sales: noted. I'll prep customer messaging after validation.
lee: Reprocess finished at 1759513970. Sample verification: AcmeCorp tokens reduced from 2.3M -> 210k after dedupe. Scheduling full backfill.
jordan: consumer restart brought lag to ~0. Found emitter ack race that can produce duplicates under partition fail — opening PR to add idempotency key check.
amanda: Keeping alerts muted for now (monitoring-only). Do not re-enable auto_notify until backfill completes and we confirm totals.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-343 updated: severity -> monitoring, last_action = manual_hold & reprocess_complete, updated_by = lee at 1759514030.
elaine: I'll draft the postmortem and send account notification templates. Assigning action items: lee (root cause & fix), jordan (consumer/ops changes), amanda (billing reconciliation).
lee: Copy — handoff to elaine. Leaving thread open for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
